references.scene: Dry season street: cracked and potholed asphalt, shops
visualRequirements: asphalt with network cracking, alligator patches and two potholes with broken edges and exposed substrate
grey concrete kerb blocks, ochre earth strip and an open concrete drain with a slab beside the road
shop row with corrugated roofs, awnings, a sign band, a produce table and a red umbrella
sagging multi-wire overhead spans on timber/concrete poles
compound wall with a base band, capped piers, steel gate and bougainvillea
roof water tanks
dust raised behind a moving truck
hard sun, deep shadows, clear blue sky
flags: The image carries a season banner drawn over it: an interface overlay, not scene content, and not evidence of a location.
The sign reads 'KANO GENERAL STORE': illustrative text, not a verified shop.

R-016, R-017 and R-018 appear to show the SAME street (mosque and shop row on the left, tarpaulin truck, large tree and compound wall with gate on the right) in three conditions, and R-019 a similar scene flooded. The right reading is one world under different seasonal and weather states, not four streets.

A mosque with a teal or green dome and minarets recurs (R-016 to R-019, R-023). As in the earlier set it is treated as a GENERIC skyline mosque, not the Kano Central Mosque (owner decision C1), unless an authentic reference says otherwise.

Kerb treatment differs between the images (plain grey stone in R-016 and R-017, black-and-yellow paint in R-018 and R-019, black-and-white paint in R-022 and R-023): they are different road classes or generator variation, not one verified rule.

Real vehicle brand marks appear in the image (a manufacturer emblem on a car grille and van front). Vehicles are not part of the environment asset set; if vehicles are built later, use generic shapes unless the owner decides to reproduce real marks.
references.referenceCamera: driver's eye, 1.4 m, in the left lane looking down the street, 28 mm

shop row, sign band, awnings and umbrella stall
pole height and sagging wire spans
